# Cole Stepanik

He is recruiting for 2027 analyst roles in sales and trading and investment banking. Contact: cole_stepanik@student.uml.edu (inquiries) or colestepanik39@gmail.com. ## AI projects
- Ownerhound (flagship, live at https://ownerhound.com): cold call workspace built by Cole. Verifies phones, owners, licenses, and business entities against company websites, state license records, and business filings before a caller dials, then runs each call on one screen (script, log, follow-up email or text, next touch). For agencies, contractors, sales teams, and searchers.
- 2nd Brain: personal operating system built on an Obsidian vault and Claude skills, synced through Google Drive; loads context per task, applies written decision rules, writes back, keeps a dated daily log. Public build guide at https://colestepanik.vercel.app/brain.html
- CCR Research Pipeline: two Claude skills that deep-learn a finance topic and produce a finished newsletter article as a PDF.

## Skills
Claude, Claude Code, Claude API, agent and skill design, Lovable, Excel (VBA), Bloomberg Terminal, Tableau, SAP/ERP.

## Pages
- [Portfolio and full resume](https://colestepanik.vercel.app/)
- [Build your own 2nd Brain](https://colestepanik.vercel.app/brain.html): free beginner guide by Cole Stepanik to building an Obsidian vault that Claude or ChatGPT reads every chat, synced through Google Drive. Windows and Mac, about 45 minutes. Nothing to unzip: after Google Drive is connected, one prompt has the AI create the vault's folders, interview you, write your notes, and make the /brain skill or ChatGPT Project instructions.
